description: Actual original shows opaque plum floor-length court gown, low square neckline, fitted structured bodice, elbow-length sleeves and gold woven borders down front, neckline/cuffs/hem. Round shoulder brooches, decorated gold belt and plum fringed wrap over forearms, pale embroidered underdress at the lower opening, gold-brown flat shoes. No headgear/armor/weapon/banner; complete standing figure before stone doorway and paving.
